brief.head: Chase cards slip this week while sealed holds steady
brief.body: The Chase 100 is down 1.4% this week at $28,498, and Modern Sealed 100 is down 0.5%. Biggest jump today: Energy Marker (E-33) (Fusion World Energy Markers), up 400% to $40.00. 135 cards worth $10+ show steady week-long gains, 869 are cooling off.

graded.basis: Modern Pokémon cards where a PSA 10 pays off best and sells at least weekly. Assumes raw at the lowest listing, PSA Standard grading ($59.99, plus upcharges when a grade is worth more than the tier covers), $15 shipping, eBay selling fees, and 30% odds of a 10 and 50% of a 9.
